campaign_brief.objective: To launch the KingSong S16 Pro as the ultimate electric unicycle for serious off-road enthusiasts and weekend explorers, highlighting its robust power and suspension.
campaign_brief.key_message: The Radboards KingSong S16 Pro offers dependable power and rugged build quality for navigating challenging terrains and extending weekend adventures.

proof_points.claim: Experience superior stability and smooth riding with dustproof X-Type suspension and 88 mm of travel.
proof_points.source: KingSong S16’s dustproof X-Type suspension, Suspension Travel: 88 mm

proof_points.claim: Conquer diverse surfaces with ease thanks to a powerful 3000W rated motor (5000W max) and a 48° gradability.
Extended adventures are possible with an up to 80 km range from its 1480 Wh battery, all riding on a durable 16-inch all-terrain tyre.
proof_points.source: 1480 Wh battery, providing a 130 km range on a free wheel (interpreted as 60-80 km Mileage in specs), Tyre Size: 16"

proof_points.claim: Built tough to support riders up to 120 kg, ensuring stability and durability.

campaign_brief.success_metric: Increase in pre-orders for KingSong S16 Pro and engagement rates on launch content.

script.title: KingSong S16 Pro: Built for Adventure

beats.line: That unexplored trail? It's calling your name.
beats.on_screen: A wide, scenic trail winding through varied terrain.

beats.line: Most boards stop where the paved road ends.
beats.on_screen: A generic board struggling or stuck on rough terrain.

beats.line: Meet the Electric Unicycle KingSong S16 Pro. Built for adventure.
beats.on_screen: Hero shot of the KingSong S16 Pro in a natural, rugged environment.

beats.line: Power through anything. A 3000W rated motor climbs 48° inclines. Experience 88 mm suspension travel.
beats.on_screen: S16 Pro ascending a steep, rocky path; close-up of suspension absorbing impact. Text: 'Rated Power: 3000W, Gradability: 48°, Suspension Travel: 88mm'

beats.line: Its 16-inch all-terrain tyre grips everywhere. Ride up to 80 km, supporting 120 kg.
beats.on_screen: S16 Pro gliding smoothly over gravel, then mud. Close-up of the 16-inch tire. Text: 'Up to 80 km range. Max Load: 120 kg. Disclosure: Range varies with rider weight, terrain, temperature.'

beats.line: Bluetooth speakers bring your music along.
beats.on_screen: Rider confidently riding the S16 Pro, subtle animation implying music playing from the board.

beats.line: Pre-order your S16 Pro today at Radboards.in.
beats.on_screen: Radboards logo and website: radboards.in. Price: ₹185,000

caption: That trail? The KingSong S16 Pro eats it for breakfast. ⛰️ A 3000W motor and 88 mm suspension glide over anything. 16-inch all-terrain tyre, 80 km range*. Bluetooth speakers. Made to order (45-60 days delivery). Pre-order for ₹185,000 at Radboards.in! (*Range varies with weight, terrain, temperature.)
